podcast.title: Filled in for James Hetfield Twice
podcast.body: John Marshall has twice stepped in to perform for James Hetfield of Metallica when Hetfield was unable to play. One instance occurred after Hetfield broke his arm skateboarding, and another when he was injured by ill-timed pyrotechnics. "He filled in twice for Hetfield. Once after Hetfield broke his arm while skateboarding and another time when he was badly synched by some ill-time pyro."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: We Are The Road Crew - A History of Roadies

podcast.title: Guitar Tech for James Hetfield
podcast.body: John Marshall is the dedicated guitar tech for James Hetfield of Metallica. He previously played guitar for the band Metal Church before taking on this role. "John Marshall is the guitar tech for Metallica's James Hetfield."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: We Are The Road Crew - A History of Roadies

xref.title: Injuries Requiring Substitute
xref.body: James Hetfield of Metallica has twice needed his guitar tech, John Marshall, to fill in for him due to injuries. One incident involved a broken arm from skateboarding, and another was a result of being badly "synched" by ill-timed pyrotechnics. "Once after Hetfield broke his arm while skateboarding and another time when he was badly synched by some ill-time pyro."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: We Are The Road Crew - A History of Roadies

xref.title: John Marshall as Guitar Tech
xref.body: Kirk Hammett of Metallica has John Marshall as his dedicated guitar tech. Marshall, who previously played guitar for Metal Church, transitioned to this role for Metallica. "John Marshall was a guitarist for the band Metal Church before he was picked to be Kirk Hammett's guitar tech in Metallica."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
